item.title: Oregon's wildfire season is pushing ranchers to evacuate their cattle
item.description: Oregon has been having an extremely active fire season. Some of the areas burning are critical to ranchers whose livelihoods depend on cattle.

item.title: Spokane fires continue to destroy buildings and displace tens of thousands
item.description: Since last weekend, the wildfires near Spokane, Wash., have displaced tens of thousands of people and destroyed hundreds of buildings in the state's second-largest city.

item.title: TMZ trades Hollywood gossip for Capitol Hill scoops with new D.C. bureau

item.title: Conservation project protects stretch of Maine's Magalloway River from development
item.description: A unique habitat embedded in a newly conserved 78,000-acre tract of land along Maine's Magalloway {muh-GAL-uh-way} River is beloved by outdoor enthusiasts.

item.title: After years of delays, alleged victims in Camp Lejeune trials may see progress
item.description: Judges handling thousands of lawsuits filed by those who believed they were sickened by the water at Camp Lejeune are now pushing for a plan for a mass settlement by October.

item.title: The role of data centers in the Democratic primaries
item.description: Democratic candidates in some key Midwestern races are focusing on data centers. Resistance to data centers is proving to be politically salient as voters distrust big tech.

item.title: Ukraine's air defenses are proving to be a weak point
item.description: Ukraine's defenses have held the line on most fronts, but there's one glaring weakness -- Russian ballistic missiles. Ukraine is desperately short of U.S.-made Patriot air defense missiles needed to defend against the Russians.
